heading: INT. SMALL CLAIMS COURT - LIVESTOCK BARN, COUNTY FAIRGROUNDS - DAY

units.text: INT. SMALL CLAIMS COURT - LIVESTOCK BARN, COUNTY FAIRGROUNDS - DAY
A long barn with sawdust floors and a raised dais built from hay pallets.
A flag, a gavel, a laminated seal.
Pens along the walls hold sleepy goats.
The air smells of hay and floor wax.
JUDGE HORTENSE BEAUMONT-LEE, 60s, in a robe over denim, presides from behind a folding table.
To her left sits the CLERK, WINNIFRED TOLLIVER, 50s, with a stack of forms and a cowbell in lieu of a bailiff's staff.
At the plaintiff's table: ARCHIBALD "ARCHIE" SPENCE, 40s, a farmer in clean overalls.
At the defendant's: DOROTHEA WEBB, 40s, a beekeeper in a veil pushed back.
Between them stands a crate that buzzes faintly.
This court is in session. Mr. Spence, you allege that Ms. Webb's bees ate your clover.
units.name: JUDGE HORTENSE

units.text: Not ate, Your Honor. Used.
units.name: ARCHIE

units.text: Used.
units.name: JUDGE HORTENSE

units.text: Eight acres. Every blossom. They didn't pay.
units.name: ARCHIE

units.text: Bees don't carry cash.
units.name: DOROTHEA

units.text: Ms. Webb, I heard that.
units.name: JUDGE HORTENSE

units.text: It was meant for the record.
units.name: DOROTHEA

units.text: Please silence your phones and your livestock.
units.name: WINNIFRED

units.text: In the front row sits TRUMAN OKONKWO, 70s, a fairground vendor in a paper hat, eating a corn dog.
This is better than the pie contest.
units.name: TRUMAN

units.text: A goat bleats.
Everyone looks at it.
The Judge sighs and taps her gavel.
Mr. Spence. What do you want?
units.name: JUDGE HORTENSE

units.text: Honey.
units.name: ARCHIE

units.text: Ms. Webb. What do you say?
units.name: JUDGE HORTENSE

units.text: I say he's welcome to a jar.
units.name: DOROTHEA

units.text: Done. Next case.
units.name: JUDGE HORTENSE

units.text: The crate buzzes louder.
Winnifred rings the cowbell.
